jobs.description:

* Health insurance
* Opportunity for advancement
* Training & development
* Vision insurance
* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discounts

**WAGE RANGE: $17.40-$20.40 PER HOUR**  
  
**The Resale Revolution Starts With You!**

As a Crossroads Buyer, you will bring our brand promise to life: to offer a fun, fashion-centered, and affordable shopping experience to our communities. You’ll hand select items to sell in our stores and provide a high-level of customer service. You’ll get customers excited about shopping and selling second-hand fashion, whether it’s their first time or their 1000th!  
  
**Minimum Requirements:**

* Must be able to work a minimum of 12 hours per week.
* 6+ months of retail experience.
* Have a good eye for fashion and current trends.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

When you join Crossroads, you are joining the sustainable fashion movement and reshaping fashion culture. And you aren’t just impacting the planet’s future- you are impacting your own.

* We have clear paths for promotion and several routes you can take as you embark on your second-hand retail journey.
* You’ll learn how to run a second-hand business– you’ll embody an entrepreneurial spirit- learning everything from buying, merchandising and inventory practices to gaining and maintaining the trust of a customer base who has been devoted since day one.

**You are:**

* **A Team Player**. You are as enthusiastic about the success of others as you are about your own success.
* **Authentic**. You are your unique self!
* **Fashion-focused.** You eat, breathe, and sleep style. Fashion is life.
* **Adaptable**. You feel comfortable adjusting to changing circumstances and encourage your teammates to do the same. We problem-solve together!
* **People**-**first**. You are energized by people. You radiate kindness and positivity! You understand your impact and are someone who uplifts others.

**You will:**

* **Engage**. You get to meet new people, every day! Greet each customer with a smile and welcome them to our store. Create a welcoming, fun, and inclusive environment to shop and work in.
* **Ask and Educate**. You will teach our customers how we work and get them excited about selling their clothes to us!
* **Have Integrity**. You will act with integrity in words and actions- do the right thing and do it right, even when it’s difficult.
* **Be Compassionate**. You will embody our core values of service, inclusion, and education. It’s important that we connect with all customers and try our best to help them.
* **Be Reliable**. You will show up to work on time and ready to go!
* **Be Flexible**. You understand that needs change and evolve throughout the day- you know how to support your team and customer as needed.
* **Enjoy Organizing.** Cleaning, organizing, and merchandising are all parts of the job and help create the best possible shopping and working environment.

**Perks:**

**Health + Wellbeing**

**We will:**

* **Support your wellbeing**. We care about our employees holistically and offer sick paid time off.
* **Prioritize wellness for all.** We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance for ALL employees who work at least 20 hours a week!

**Work/Life Harmony**

**We will:**

* **Give you incentives when you work during the holidays.** We pay time and a half on select holidays throughout the year, and we are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.
* **Encourage work/life balance.** We offer flexible scheduling so that you can meet work & life needs!

**Financial Health**

**We will:**

* **Contribute to your 401(k)**. Free money? We’ll match up to 4% of your contribution as soon as you enroll & an additional discretionary 2% at year-end! We offer both a Roth and traditional 401(k).
* **Offer** a generousdiscount on all merchandise including luxury consignment pieces- shop where you work!
* **Be Transparent.** We have clear pay ranges and always advertise pay for positions. We believe in pay equity.
* **Offer Earned Wage Access.** Need money before payday? You’ll be able to access pay as you earn it through our partner app ZayZoon
* **Contribute** **to Commuter Benefits**. Take public transit? We’ll contribute and match a portion of your commuter account monthly.

**Growth + Development**

**We will:**

* **Let you take the lead.** We offer clear paths for growth and ongoing professional development that are straightforward and attainable.
* **Celebrate with you**. We’ll provide you with many opportunities to bond with your team as you celebrate successes together.
* **Equip you with the tools to be successful**. As you onboard & throughout your career, our training programs will set you up to win.

**About Crossroads**

One of the first companies to pioneer secondhand clothing as an alternative to traditional retail, Crossroads Trading has been buying, selling, and consigning name brand and designer clothing in a friendly, fun, and fashionable atmosphere since 1991.

Since opening the doors of its first location in the heart of San Francisco’s Fillmore District, Crossroads has expanded over time to 38 retail locations spanning Northern and Southern California, Chicago, Seattle, Portland, Denver, New York, and Houston. And in recent years, we have added Sell-By-Mail and Concierge programs to provide convenient new ways for fashionable and eco-conscious customers to sell their gently used clothing.

Crossroads has been featured in Harper’s Bazaar, Teen Vogue, and LA Mag, and is widely recognized as an industry leader in the ‘resale revolution.’

**If you like sustainability, fashion, and working in a fun, positive environment, you’ll enjoy a career with us!**

We are bringing paid media in-house. Google and Meta have been run externally, and we want someone in the US who plans and judges every dollar against US and Canadian goals. Twelve months in, our paid media will be one of the most reliable growth engines in the business. You will have built a well-structured, high-performing Google and Meta program that scales with confidence, with every dollar tied to the company plan and reported against it month by month. Conversion and demand generation will each run on their own budget and scorecard, Triple Whale will be the trusted source of truth for what works, and a steady test rhythm will keep the creative team building against real results. * Onboard new team members to CIP program processes, tools, and expectations.
Model self-directed ownership by independently scoping, planning, and executing compliance initiatives with minimal oversight, keeping leadership informed of progress and risk.

* Deep working knowledge of NERC CIP standards and regulatory frameworks, with experience leading or supporting audit and self-certification activities.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, own initiatives end to end, and mentor or informally lead peers (required).

* Technical knowledge of network infrastructure, industrial control systems (ICS), operational technology (OT), and/or security tools (preferred).
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to independently analyze compliance requirements, translate them into actionable plans, and guide others in executing them.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear documentation and interact effectively with internal teams, leadership, and regulators.

The Los Angeles County Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH)consolidates our countywide response to homelessness. The driving force behind HSH is increasing accountability and transparency, improving care for people experiencing or at risk of homelessness, and streamlining collaboration with partners including services providers, the County’s 88 cities, and unincorporated areas to deliver high-quality, life-saving services. Staff schedules are based on business need and may include the option of a hybrid work schedule where employees work remotely and from the office.

This position performs complex fiscal analysis, budgeting, forecasting, claiming, and financial reporting to support the Department of Homeless Services and Housing’s financial operations and ensure the effective and accountable management of departmental resources. Responsibilities include developing and monitoring budgets and annual financial plans; preparing reimbursement claims; projecting expenditures and revenues; monitoring funding utilization and contract expenditures; and performing financial reconciliations. The position analyzes financial data to identify trends, variances, funding concerns, and other fiscal issues and recommends corrective actions as needed. The position also provides fiscal guidance and support across the Department, assists with audits and contract fiscal monitoring, and completes special fiscal analyses and assignments.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Analyzes reimbursement requirements for Federal, State, grant-funded, and other special programs to ensure claims comply with applicable regulations and maximize revenue recovery.
* Prepares and supports claims, billings, cost reports, mandated financial reports, and other reimbursement documentation.
* Conducts complex fiscal analyses and develops financial management reports, including expenditure analyses, revenue forecasts, cost studies, and financial projections.
* Develops and monitors annual financial plans, program budgets, and funding allocations; analyzes performance against established budgets and provides recommendations to management.
* Reviews and reconciles financial and program data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial reporting.
* Tracks expenditures and revenues for programs supported by multiple and braided funding sources and ensures costs are appropriately allocated to available funding.
* Develops, analyzes, and monitors reimbursement, administrative, and billing rates to reflect actual costs and maximize cost recovery.
* Analyzes contractual funding and costs and assists in developing financial rates and allocations for agreements with County and non-County providers.
* Reviews and interprets grant and funding requirements and monitors compliance with fiscal, regulatory, reporting, and reimbursement requirements.
* Supports Federal, State, grantor, Single Audit, Auditor-Controller, and annual financial audits, including preparation of supporting documentation and responses to audit findings.
* Assists with contract fiscal monitoring, identifies fiscal or compliance issues, and assists in developing and monitoring corrective action plans.
* Analyzes program performance and financial data to identify trends, discrepancies, operational issues, and opportunities for corrective action or improved cost effectiveness.
* Evaluates accounting and financial processes and recommends improvements to systems, procedures, controls, and reporting practices.
* Develops and updates fiscal policies and procedures related to accounting controls, internal controls, financial reporting, recordkeeping, and audit trails.
* Assists with budget development, forecasting, financial reporting, claims and billings, and year-end closing activities.
* Coordinates department-wide financial assignments and reporting requirements with Finance team members and other organizational units.
* Serves as a Finance liaison to Program Offices and other key stakeholders, providing fiscal guidance and participating in discussions involving budgets, funding, expenditures, contracts, claims, and financial compliance.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**

Completion of accounting courses in an accredited college equivalent to 21 semester units or 32 quarter units including at least two courses in advanced accounting subjects such as governmental accounting, computerized accounting or auditing -AND- One year of professional accounting or responsible staff experience in health care financial operations.

Coeur d’Alene area, Idaho | On-site; hybrid or remote considered for exceptional candidates | Reports to the CFO

Selkirk Sport is hiring an FP&A Manager to lead financial planning, forecasting and business analysis as we expand internationally and build a broader ecosystem of pickleball brands, products and experiences.

Strong finance fundamentals and hands-on AI experience are essential. You’ll build and operate AI agents and automated workflows that improve forecasting, reporting and financial quality checks, with reliable results and measurable business value.

**What you’ll own**

* **Planning and forecasting.** Own the revenue forecast, integrated 3-statement model, monthly rolling forecasts, annual budget and scenario analysis. Build and maintain a rolling 13-week cash forecast, connecting operating assumptions, inventory, headcount and working capital to profitability and cash.
* **Modeling key initiatives.** Build financial models that help leadership evaluate strategic initiatives, compare alternatives and understand the implications for earnings, cash and resources. Make clear recommendations supported by documented assumptions and analysis.
* **Justified spend.** Embed our principle that all spend requires justification into planning and business decisions. Establish consistent standards for evaluating proposed and recurring spend, challenge assumptions, quantify costs and expected benefits, and track whether approved spending delivers the intended results.
* **Management reporting, key insights and action.** Own the monthly financial package, KPIs and commentary for our Co-CEOs, Board and investors. Identify the key performance drivers, emerging risks and opportunities, and implications for the forecast. Translate those insights into specific recommended actions and priorities for leadership, and track follow-through with department owners.
* **M&A and international growth.** Support diligence, valuation, transaction modeling and post-acquisition integration. Develop reporting that scales across brands and entities, and track acquired-business performance and integration benefits.
* **Business partnership.** Work with department leaders to develop budgets, evaluate spending, understand results and act on financial insight. Bring constructive challenge and clear recommendations to the discussion.

* Demonstrated experience building and operating AI agents or automated workflows used in recurring business processes, with measurable results.

**About Selkirk Sport**

Founded in North Idaho, Selkirk Sport is the leading global pickleball brand. We serve players through direct-to-consumer, wholesale, major retail and international channels.

We’re building a pickleball-centric ecosystem of brands, products and experiences. Our 2026 acquisition of Bread & Butter Pickleball Company is part of that strategy, alongside expansion into new channels and countries and continued acquisition opportunities.

Our mission is to fuel the pickleball obsession found inside every player. Finance plays a central role in helping us  
pursue that mission with disciplined planning and investment.

**About the Role**
------------------

Coeur d’Alene area, Idaho | On-site; hybrid or remote considered for exceptional candidates | Reports to the CFO

Selkirk Sport is hiring an FP&A Manager to lead financial planning, forecasting and business analysis as we expand internationally and build a broader ecosystem of pickleball brands, products and experiences.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you’ll own the financial models and reporting that guide decisions on key initiatives, acquisitions, international expansion and capital allocation. You’ll lead a small global FP&A team while staying hands-on with modeling, analysis and the quality of the team’s work.

Strong finance fundamentals and hands-on AI experience are essential. You’ll build and operate AI agents and automated workflows that improve forecasting, reporting and financial quality checks, with reliable results and measurable business value.

**What you’ll own**
-------------------

* **Planning and forecasting.** Own the revenue forecast, integrated 3-statement model, monthly rolling forecasts, annual budget and scenario analysis. Build and maintain a rolling 13-week cash forecast, connecting operating assumptions, inventory, headcount and working capital to profitability and cash.
* **Modeling key initiatives.** Build financial models that help leadership evaluate strategic initiatives, compare alternatives and understand the implications for earnings, cash and resources. Make clear recommendations supported by documented assumptions and analysis.
* **Justified spend.** Embed our principle that all spend requires justification into planning and business decisions. Establish consistent standards for evaluating proposed and recurring spend, challenge assumptions, quantify costs and expected benefits, and track whether approved spending delivers the intended results.
* **Management reporting, key insights and action.** Own the monthly financial package, KPIs and commentary for our Co-CEOs, Board and investors. Identify the key performance drivers, emerging risks and opportunities, and implications for the forecast. Translate those insights into specific recommended actions and priorities for leadership, and track follow-through with department owners.
* **M&A and international growth.** Support diligence, valuation, transaction modeling and post-acquisition integration. Develop reporting that scales across brands and entities, and track acquired-business performance and integration benefits.
* **Business partnership.** Work with department leaders to develop budgets, evaluate spending, understand results and act on financial insight. Bring constructive challenge and clear recommendations to the discussion.
* **Team leadership.** Lead a senior financial analyst in Malaysia and a part-time FP&A data specialist. Set clear deliverables, review standards and deadlines, develop their capabilities, and remain accountable for accurate, timely work.

**AI and finance systems**
--------------------------

Building and running AI agents is a core responsibility of this role.

You’ll use Claude, Palantir AIP and other approved tools to develop agents and automated workflows for recurring reporting, analysis, forecasting and quality checks. You’ll own the finance use case, testing, ongoing monitoring and exception handling, partnering with our Digital team on data access, integrations and deployment. Material financial conclusions will remain subject to human review.

You should be able to demonstrate an agent or automation you’ve built and explain its data connections, how you tested it, how you handle failures and the business results. A sanitized demonstration is welcome.

You’ll also help shape our planning and reporting systems, including the Finance Reporting Hub, BI tools and an upcoming accounting platform transition.

During your first year, you and the CFO will agree on two or three high-impact projects, including putting at least one validated AI agent into recurring finance use.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 5+ years of progressive FP&A or corporate finance experience, including experience leading analysts.
* Expert 3-statement modeling, forecasting and budgeting skills in Excel and Google Sheets.
* Demonstrated experience building and operating AI agents or automated workflows used in recurring business processes, with measurable results.
* Strong technical fluency, including experience with BI, data platforms, SQL and FP&A tools.
* The ability to explain complex financial results clearly and make a recommendation supported by analysis.
* A record of managing multiple priorities and delivering accurate work on deadline with limited supervision.
* A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field.

Additional experience we value includes M&A, valuation, acquisition integration, multi-entity or international finance, consumer products, e-commerce and leading remote teams. An MBA, CPA or CFA is a plus.

**Location and schedule**
-------------------------

This role is based on-site at our headquarters in the Coeur d’Alene area of North Idaho. Hybrid or remote arrangements may be considered for an exceptional candidate, with an agreed cadence of regular HQ visits and additional presence during onboarding, planning cycles and key strategic meetings.

**About Snipp**

Snipp Interactive is a global provider of promotions and loyalty technology, helping brands turn transactions into relationships. Our platform supports receipt-based promotions, consumer rebates, and enterprise loyalty solutions - trusted by leading CPG, retail, and B2B companies worldwide.

**The Opportunity**

Snipp is looking for a data-driven Digital Media Buyer to plan, launch, optimize, and report on paid media campaigns that support client promotions, loyalty programs, and digital engagement initiatives. Snipp is a global loyalty and promotions technology company working with major consumer brands, retailers, QSRs, beverage companies, and their agencies. You'll own day-to-day media buying and performance optimization across paid digital channels, balancing campaign goals, audience strategy, budget pacing, creative performance, and measurable return.

You'll manage paid media campaigns from planning through wrap-up, partnering with Client Services, Sales, Creative, Analytics, and external platform or agency partners. You'll translate campaign objectives into channel plans, audiences, budgets, flighting, testing strategies, and reporting that clients and internal teams can understand and act on. This role requires both hands-on platform execution and strong analytical judgment. You'll be expected to identify performance issues quickly, recommend changes, and clearly explain the trade-offs behind budget and optimization decisions.

**What****you'll****do****:**

* Plan and execute paid digital media campaigns across relevant channels such as paid social, paid search, display/programmatic, video, and other performance-media placements based on client objectives and target audiences.
* Build media plans that define channel mix, audience strategy, budget allocation, flighting, expected benchmarks, measurement approach, and optimization cadence.
* Own campaign setup and trafficking, including targeting, bids, budgets, placements, creative rotation, tracking parameters, conversion events, and quality checks before launch.
* Monitor campaign pacing and performance daily or as required, and optimize toward agreed KPIs such as reach, impressions, CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, conversion rate, ROAS, or other client-specific outcomes.
* Run structured tests across audiences, creative, placements, bidding approaches, landing experiences, and channel mix, and document what changed and why.
* Maintain accurate budgets and forecasts, flag under- or over-pacing early, and recommend reallocations before performance or delivery becomes an escalation.
* Partner with Analytics and client-facing teams to ensure reporting is accurate, actionable, and tied back to campaign objectives rather than platform metrics alone.
Work with other teams to identify asset needs, manage platform specifications and deadlines, and surface performance insights that can improve future creative.

  

### **Requirements**

**What****we're****looking for:**

* 3-5 years of hands-on digital media buying or performance marketing experience, ideally in an agency, marketing-technology, promotions, loyalty, retail-media, or consumer-brand environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing meaningful paid-media budgets and optimizing campaigns across multiple digital channels.
* Hands-on proficiency with major paid-media platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and/or programmatic DSPs, with the ability to learn additional platforms quickly.
* Strong understanding of core paid-media metrics and how they connect to campaign goals, including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, conversion rate, frequency, reach, and ROAS.
* Comfort with campaign tracking concepts such as pixels, conversion events, UTMs, attribution windows, tag management, and the practical limitations created by privacy changes and platform measurement.
* Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and the ability to analyze performance data, spot anomalies, and communicate recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain campaign performance and optimization decisions to client-facing teams and enterprise stakeholders.
Experience with promotions, loyalty, shopper marketing, retail media, or CPG campaigns is a strong plus.

**Location:**

* Remote, North America: US-based is preferred. The company is distributed nationally and internationally, so the majority of communication occurs electronically.
Comfort working with distributed teams and clients across time zones, with occasional schedule flexibility around launches, reporting deadlines, or campaign issues.  

**Compensation:**

* The typical hiring range for this role is $80,000–$110,000 annually. This range reflects our commitment to our compensation philosophy, internal equity, and comes with a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package. Base pay will be determined based on role-related skills, knowledge, and experience.
